description: This is an abstract Java class for asserting properties of ThingCommand objects within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to verify entity IDs and thing IDs in command assertions.

classes.name: AbstractThingCommandAssert
classes.description: An abstract assertion class for verifying properties of ThingCommand objects in testing scenarios.

methods.name: AbstractThingCommandAssert
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the assertion object with the actual command and its self-type class.

methods.name: withId
methods.description: Asserts that the command's entity ID matches the expected ID, wrapping it into a ThingId if necessary.

methods.name: withId
methods.description: Asserts that the command's thing entity ID matches the expected ThingId.

methods.name: withId(CharSequence)
methods.description: Checks if the command's entity ID matches the provided CharSequence, converting it into a ThingId.

methods.name: withId(ThingId)
methods.description: Checks if the command's Thing entity ID matches the provided ThingId.
